name: proofbundle-guard
description: Guard Preview of proofbundle under Codex, the house profile of b7n0de: after you trust the hooks, they check declared repository evidence before supported push, pull request or release actions. Install it beside proofbundle; it adds no skill and no MCP server.

hooks.command: python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --host codex || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --host codex || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --host codex || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" stop --host codex || { echo 'proofbundle done check: the check could not run, so the session goes on' >&2; exit 2; }
